category_definitions.CATEGORY_A_REFERENCE: High-confidence experimentally characterized human kinase reference controls (CONGRUENT_REFERENCE).
category_definitions.CATEGORY_B_NATURAL_EXCEPTION: Natural pseudokinases and divergent kinases requiring biological contextualization (NATURAL_EXCEPTION).
category_definitions.CATEGORY_C_SYNTHETIC_LABEL: Controlled functional label swaps between Tyrosine kinase and Ser/Thr kinase activities (SYNTHETIC_LABEL_CONTRADICTION).
category_definitions.CATEGORY_D_SYNTHETIC_SEQUENCE: Controlled catalytic triad mutations (VAIK, HRD, DFG knockouts) testing sensitivity to catalytic disruptions (SYNTHETIC_SEQUENCE_PERTURBATION).
category_definitions.CATEGORY_C_SYNTHETIC_CONTROL: Unaltered canonical sequence and annotation negative controls (CONGRUENT_CONTROL).

Real-world misannotation accuracy cannot be claimed without independent experimental verification. Current results evaluate controlled sensitivity, not public database error rates.

scientific_limitations: Global mean-pooled ESM-2 embeddings (8M) are dominated by tertiary fold homology; point mutations in long sequences produce small cosine shifts (<0.001).
Unsupervised sequence representations cannot detect label discordance unless conditioned on functional class annotations.
Sequence similarity baseline outperforms embeddings for label swaps because alignment directly matches homologous residues with known experimental labels.
Pseudokinases represent legitimate evolutionary exceptions, not database errors.
